description:
[Workflow Status: Open] [Audit Requirement: AQL 1.5 Workmanship Standard] [Risk: HIGH] [CAP Required: YES] [Verification: Physical Floor Re-inspection]

The sewing machine work area is not properly maintained, with loose pneumatic hoses and cables lying across the workstation. Additionally, the fire extinguisher access appears to be partially obstructed by the sewing machine and other equipment, which may create safety risks and delay emergency access.

cap.immediateCorrection: Remove and properly arrange the loose air hoses and cables to avoid entanglement and workplace hazards.
cap.correctiveAction: Provide proper hose and cable management arrangements to prevent loose cables and hoses from spreading across the workstation.
